name: ANIL
tagline: Almost No Inner Loop: SGD adapts only the classifier head; backbone frozen during inner loop.
pseudocode:
1. At init, identify head parameters by name ('classifier').
2. Per inner step on the support set:
3. \quad Re-resolve head params (l2l update_module replaces parameter ids).
4. \quad Compute loss $L_S$, take grads only w.r.t. head params (create_graph=True).
5. \quad Build update list: $-\eta\,\nabla_{\theta_h}L_S$ for head, zero for backbone.
6. \quad $\theta \leftarrow \text{update\_module}(\theta, \text{updates})$.
7. Outer loop trains $\theta_0$ via second-order MAML through head-only inner steps.
diff_from_baseline: Raghu et al., 'Rapid Learning or Feature Reuse? Towards Understanding the Effectiveness of MAML' (ICLR 2020). Tests the feature-reuse hypothesis by collapsing MAML's inner loop to just the head.

name: MAML
tagline: Vanilla second-order MAML: inner-loop SGD with a fixed learning rate over all parameters.
diff_from_baseline: Finn, Abbeel, Levine, 'Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning' (ICML 2017). Default reference for gradient-based meta-learning; full-network adaptation via second-order outer-loop differentiation.

name: Meta-SGD
tagline: MAML with a learnable per-parameter learning-rate vector that the outer loop optimizes.
diff_from_baseline: Li, Zhou, Chen, Li, 'Meta-SGD: Learning to Learn Quickly for Few-Shot Learning' (2017, arXiv:1707.09835). Adds a meta-learned LR vector; can absorb both step size and (sign of) update direction per parameter.
